text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 11 · 魔法学院草药温室.
Environment:  Original magical academy herbology greenhouse, gently arched aged cream-painted iron framework and slightly misted clear glass panes, long oak potting benches along both sides, terracotta pots, delicate silvery ferns and rare translucent pale-green leaves catching daylight. Broad clear central aisle toward open arched glass door, orderly jars and folded linen gardening cloths. Plants are purely botanical with NO faces, eyes, mouths, limbs, humanoid roots or sentient creatures. Bright soft daylight, tangible cinematic practical set, subtle wonder rather than neon effects, no crests or franchise emblems.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 4 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第2批 · 11 · 魔法学院草药温室. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. A 2x2 sheet of FOUR distinct eye-level camera views of the SAME ONE space: original forward direction, a lateral oblique view, a reverse view 180 degrees opposite, and the other lateral view. Labels A B C D only. Preserve ALL door/window/furniture positions; actually move camera, never mirror the building. Same material and lighting. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
